deployment.caveat: The first published frame is an opening position, not a complete record of deployment. No reserve-frequency tally contribution.

lessons.text: Stage a second response group outside the lane taking the first assault. The northern group stays separate through the central convergence, then shifts inward.
Treat a forward unit as time and space, not immunity from melee. Blood Angels reach the right-side threats, and the Defiler leaves the board while Magnus remains.

Track points while absorbing pressure: the visible lead is 24–8, later 24–19, before the closing update. A winning plan can lose an expensive model; this footage does not prove that trade was optimal.

tracking.method: Coarse contact sheet, then denser samples around first contact, major relocation, removal and closing score. Selected full-resolution frames inspected. Generic groups are not tracked as individual units; arrows only join confident visual re-identifications.
tracking.limitations: Sampled visual analysis; missing actions, exact measurements and ability use remain unknown. No hidden models or off-screen casualties reconstructed.
tracking.rosterCorrection: Full Yarin list identifies a Defiler, not a Mutalith. Roster plus mechanical silhouette supports that label; northern Scarab group remains probable.

analysis.heading: What happened
analysis.text: 21 August 2026 · 11th edition · indexed win 100–32; closing overlay 90–22. Yarin has the shared Magnus/ten-Scarab/Vortex Prince core, but adds a 330-point Defiler and three Spawn units, with only one Rubric squad. Blood Angels reach his forward line; the Defiler is off-table by 02:10 while Magnus remains. The likely northern Scarab group later shifts down as the right-side BA concentration thins. A substantial second response remains after the first collision.

analysis.heading: Magnus and reserves
analysis.text: In the opening sampled board states TS are on the right. Magnus is behind the centre-right forward line; the probable Scarab brick occupies the northern pocket. These establish early positions, not complete deployment declarations. No verified Prince/Terminator reserve declaration or arrival sequence was recovered. English captions could not be retrieved (HTTP 429), so no deep-strike turn or Crystal use is asserted.

analysis.heading: Transfer to your list
analysis.text: Preserve an independent reply when the front unit gets hit. Your list has neither the Defiler nor three Spawn units, so it cannot reproduce Yarin’s exact damage absorption. Use his separation of threats as a practice question, not permission to expose a 455-point Magnus.
